trust_decision.summary: Untrusted CSS text passed to parse() is matched by anchored regexes inside the parser; each regex must run in linear time on attacker-shaped input (the @custom-media regex had overlapping `\s*` / `[^{;]+` that backtracks polynomially when the terminating ';' is missing).

landing_point.why: History entry says 'redos ... specific crafted css string'; the only regex the security fix rewrites is the @custom-media matcher in atcustommedia(), a single-file parser.

fix_sites.entry_point: parse(css) public API (src/index.ts:3) -> rules() -> atrule() -> atcustommedia()
fix_sites.module_kind: parser (core library, same file as all parsing)
parser; functional change for :is() nested parens (#211), not the ReDoS fix per History (fix.diff:13-14)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All parsing lives in src/parse/index.ts; stringify (src/stringify/compiler.ts) uses no regexes on input per grep; no second implementation, wrapper or legacy path.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Other at-rule/declaration regexes are 'different grammar productions' not named in the report, and a solver can argue only @custom-media was reported.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: @custom-media with name and media query split across line breaks and whitespace before ';' must still parse (test case custom-media-linebreak); an over-broad fix that forbids newlines or trailing whitespace breaks it.

O6_input_shapes: @custom-media with long whitespace run between name and query and no terminating ';' (fix requires the query to start with a non-space char: fix.diff:81)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: _compileAtrule regex for @import/@charset/@namespace: `(?::?[^;'"]|...)+` lets ':' be consumed two ways, so an unterminated quote after many ':' can force heavy backtracking.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Shared helper for 'simple' non-block at-rules, not @custom-media; looks unrelated to the report.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~130 lines below landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: declaration value regex: alternative `\([^)]*?\)` rescans to end of input for each '(' with no ')', which gives quadratic cost on a value with many unclosed '('.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Declarations are a different production; quadratic rather than exponential, so it can be argued to be only a perf issue.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: selector comma-protection regex `\(.*?\)` (and the fix's own replacement `\(.*?(\(.*?\))*\)`) rescans the line for each unclosed '('.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Fix touched it only for a functional :is() bug; the solver can treat it as a feature regex.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: @layer / @container / @supports matchers could plausibly be written with a trailing `\s*` + `[^{;]+` + required ';' like custom-media
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: They are sibling at-rule matchers in the same style; a maintainer adding a statement-form at-rule would copy the custom-media idiom.

O9_family: ReDoS / inefficient regular expression in CSS parser (CWE-1333)

O10_build.toolchain: Node + yarn, parcel build, jest via ts-jest (package.json:33-44)
O10_build.project_tests: test/cases.test.ts fixture runner over test/cases/* (custom-media, custom-media-linebreak), test/parse.test.ts

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Rewrite only the @custom-media regex (or add a length cap there) and leave the other at-rule/declaration regexes untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix's new selector regex `\(.*?(\(.*?\))*\)` (fix.diff:70) adds a nested lazy quantifier, which may itself be a ReDoS candidate post-fix; not pursued.
